name: boiled leather
lore_descriptor: boiled to near-rigidity; dense, dark, half-armor in itself
first_pickup_chronicle: Boiled leather. Cuir bouilli. Plunged into hot wax until it hardens to near-bone density. The poor man's plate — and surprisingly close to the rich man's.
design_notes: Mid-band leather, pf 30. Mult 1.0, weight 1.0, enchant 2. Continues the leather progression between cured_leather and drakeskin.
